description: Find gift ideas for a specific person and occasion. Searches TrueGift's published gift guides and returns concrete product picks (with the reason each fits) plus the best-matching guides. Examples: recipient="mom", occasion="christmas", max_budget_usd=50; recipient="coworker", occasion="secret-santa", interests="coffee".

max_budget_usd.description: Budget ceiling in USD; 0 means no limit.

recipient.description: Who the gift is for (mom, dad, coworker, teen, wife...).

name: find_gift_ideas
title: Find gift ideas for a person or occasion
